opportunities.title: Copy-Paste Publishing Assistant(s) for a Nonprofit — 200 Listings/Day Catch-Up, Then Ongoing All Summer (Fully Prepared Content, Manual Only)
opportunities.description: Copy-Paste Publishing Assistant(s) for a Nonprofit — 200 Listings/Day Catch-Up, Then Ongoing All Summer (Fully Prepared Content, Manual Only) Category / skills: Data Entry, Virtual Assistant, Copy Typing Description: We're a U.S. 501(c)(3) nonprofit that arranges services for seniors, veterans, disabled neighbors, and families facing hardship. We've built an internal system that automatically writes a recruiting listing for every neighbor who needs help — privacy-screened, fully composed, ready to go. What we need is a human publishing partner (individual or small team) who copies each prepared listing from our private dashboard and pastes it onto a well-known volunteer-recruitment website, by hand. Why by hand? Compliance. The destination website's terms require listings to be reviewed and published by a real person. So this role is 100% manual and that's non-negotiable: no bots, no scrapers, no browser automation, no macros, no scripts — ever. Any automation ends the engagement immediately. ** You are the human in the middle; that's the entire point of the role. ** The task, precisely. Each listing on the destination site is a 5-page form with about 25 fields (title, description, location, time commitment, screening questions, category tags, etc.). Sounds heavy — it isn't: We supply every field. Each card on our dashboard shows the exact text for all 25 fields, page by page, in the same order as the form. You never write, guess, or improvise anything. ~21 of the 25 fields are identical every time. The site has a "duplicate listing" feature — after your first listing, you duplicate and change only what's unique: the title (each carries its own reference code that must be pasted exactly, never shortened), the description, the city, and the photo. The photo is one click. Our dashboard generates a custom image per listing — click download, upload to the form, done. After publishing, click "Mark posted ✓" on our dashboard. Our system verifies it automatically — that's how completed work is counted. With rhythm, each listing takes 2–4 minutes: duplicate → paste title → paste description → set city → download/upload photo → publish → mark posted. The volume, in two phases: Phase 1 — Catch-up: ~3,000 listings at ~200/day (roughly 3 weeks). This clears our 90-day backlog of neighbors waiting for help. Phase 2 — Ongoing: ~25–50/day for the rest of the summer at least, as new requests arrive daily. Strong Phase 1 performers get first claim on this follow-up project. Teams welcome. 200/day is a full focused day for one person — so if you run a small team, our dashboard is built for it: each teammate types their name, claims a batch of listings with one click, and those listings leave everyone else's queue. Assignments are exclusive, so two people can never post the same listing. You split the day's 200 however you like. What this is NOT: no writing, no research, no calls, no customer contact, no handling of personal data (our system strips all of that before you ever see a listing). Accuracy beats speed — we spot-check, and reference codes must match character-for-character. Access: you'll be invited to the destination site under our organization's account with your own login, plus a password link to our dashboard. Nothing to install. Pay & structure: Quote us your flat daily rate for 200 completed listings (a "completed listing" = published on the site and marked posted on our dashboard, where it's verified automatically; partial days pro-rated). Also quote your rate for the Phase 2 maintenance pace (25–50/day). We start with a small paid trial batch of 10 listings to confirm fit before awarding the ongoing work. To apply: start your proposal with the word MOWER so we know you read this. Then: (1) Your high-volume form/data-entry experience — where? (2) Confirm in your own words that this must be done entirely by hand, no automation of any kind. (3) Your flat rate for one day of 200 completed listings, your Phase 2 rate, and whether you're solo or a team (how many people, hours, timezone).

opportunities.title: Gestión Documental ISO SharePoint
opportunities.description: Quiero crear una aplicación en SharePoint que me ayude a cumplir los requisitos de la norma ISO mediante una gestión de documentos ágil y segura. El foco principal es la Gestión de documentos y, dentro de ella, necesito que la solución incorpore: • Control de versiones para asegurar la trazabilidad completa de cada archivo. • Permisos de acceso granulares que faciliten aprobaciones y ediciones diferenciadas por rol. • Plantillas de documentos pre-configuradas para estandarizar formatos y metadatos. Aún no he definido si el acceso estará limitado a grupos o roles concretos, por lo que agradeceré tu orientación sobre las mejores prácticas en SharePoint Online, así como la posible integración con Azure AD o Microsoft 365 grupos. Lo que espero recibir: 1. Estructura del sitio o colección de sitios orientada a ISO (bibliotecas, columnas, flujos de aprobación). 2. Configuración de versiones, permisos y plantillas lista para usarse. 3. Documentación breve con capturas donde se explique cómo mantener y escalar la solución. 4. Recomendaciones para futuras automatizaciones con Power Automate si fuese necesario. Si ya has implementado soluciones similares, cuéntame brevemente tu enfoque y el tiempo estimado. Busco una implementación clara, replicable y bien documentada.

opportunities.title: Resolve WordPress Crawl Errors (Google flagged destination error but website is fully live)
opportunities.description: Google Ads has paused every campaign on the grounds of “destination error – URL not working,” yet the site loads perfectly for users and my host can’t see any server-side fault. Google’s own crawl test, however, is failing for the entire site. I need an experienced WordPress troubleshooter who can dig into the core of the problem, pinpoint why Googlebot cannot render the site, and implement a clean fix. No recent changes have been deployed, and the site is largely multimedia-driven (images and videos embedded throughout), so I’m looking for someone who understands how themes, plugins, robots.txt, sitemaps, caching layers, CDNs, and core web vitals interplay with Google’s crawler. Deliverables • Identify the exact crawl issue and provide a brief report outlining the root cause. • Apply the necessary code, configuration, or server-side adjustments to resolve it. • Validate the repair by getting the URL Inspection tool in Search Console to return “URL is on Google” and reinstate campaign eligibility. Acceptance will be based on a successful crawl test screenshot and restoration of ad delivery status.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40777881, publicado hace 2 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

opportunities.title: Hiring Freelance 3D Developer / Team – Interactive Maritime Equipment Training Platform
opportunities.description: Project: Interactive 3D Maritime Equipment Training Platform We are seeking an experienced freelance 3D Developer, Interactive Simulation Specialist, or small development team for an upcoming maritime technical training project in India. Our Objective: We intend to develop an interactive, web-based 3D training platform focused on shipboard machinery, marine automation, monitoring, and safety systems. Equipment and Systems (Indicative Scope): Boiler Systems Inert Gas (IG) Systems Purifiers Oily Water Separators (OWS) Oil Discharge Monitoring Equipment (ODME) Oil Mist Detectors (OMD) Alarm Monitoring Systems Cargo Monitoring Systems Fire Detection Systems Fire Suppression Systems Safety & Shutdown Systems Expected Development Capabilities: Realistic 3D modeling of marine equipment and machinery Interactive 3D visualization with rotation, zoom, and component exploration Clickable components displaying equipment names, functions, and technical information Equipment operation and process-flow animations, where required Web-based interactive training modules Potential integration of troubleshooting scenarios, assessments, and additional training features Preferred Technical Skills: Blender, Three.js, WebGL, React Three Fiber, Unity, Unreal Engine, 3D Modeling, Industrial Simulation, and Interactive Web Development. Who We Are Looking For We prefer freelancers or development teams with proven experience in interactive 3D applications, industrial equipment visualization, technical training simulations, or similar projects. Experience in maritime, marine engineering, or industrial automation projects would be an advantage. Important – Current Stage of the Project At this stage, we are identifying and shortlisting technically capable freelancers or teams. The final project scope, equipment selection, technical specifications, development approach, budget, and timeline will be discussed and finalized directly with our management team. Equipment photographs, engineering drawings, and technical reference materials may be provided during subsequent discussions. Interested Candidates Should Share: Portfolio with relevant completed projects. Live demonstrations of interactive 3D applications, if available. Experience in industrial equipment modeling or training simulations. Technologies and development tools used. Ability to handle a complete project involving multiple equipment training modules. Availability for an online technical discussion with our management team. Location Preference: India-based freelancers or development teams preferred. We are looking for a technically capable and reliable development partner for a potentially larger, long-term project.

opportunities.title: Moodle Enhancement: WhatsApp, Google Tools, Social Media -- 2
opportunities.description: Al Kithab Academy is an online Islamic educational academy. Our public website and learning management system run on Moodle 4.5 (LTS) at alkithabacademy.com, hosted on a Hostinger VPS (Ubuntu, nginx, PHP 8.3, MariaDB, Redis). The previous developer has finished his engagement. Most of the system is built as custom Moodle plugins: the theme, public website, portals, publications, certificates and a Google Meet module. A full handover document is available. We need an experienced Moodle developer to secure the system, complete the outstanding work and add new features. Stage 1 – Take over and secure the system - Review the existing code and handover document, and confirm what is complete - Security check of the server and Moodle: remove all previous developer access (SSH keys, server users, admin accounts) and check for any unknown users, scheduled tasks or code - Change the database, e-mail and server passwords safely, without breaking the site - Set up regular backups of the database and Moodle data, stored off the server - Set up a staging copy of the site for testing Stage 2 – Complete the Academy portals and admin customisation - Customise the Student, Teacher, Headmistress, Admin and Guest portals to match our approved designs, so that the portals look and work as part of the Academy site rather than as standard Moodle pages - Approved designs for the Student portal are ready and will be shared. Designs for the other portals will follow. - WordPress-style customisation in the Admin portal: the admin can edit the public website and portal pages from the admin area without code, including text, images, colours, menus and page sections, with a preview before changes go live - Complete the remaining items from our corrections list (provided after hiring) Stage 3 – Payments, Google Meet and new features Payment gateway - Integrate our Sri Lankan bank payment gateway with Moodle payments, replacing the current test gateway, with automatic course enrolment Google Meet attendance - Complete attendance through Google Workspace: join and leave times, and duration, recorded in the portal's attendance WhatsApp integration (WhatsApp Business API) - Registration OTPs sent by WhatsApp - Class reminders to teachers and students before each class - Welcome messages for new students and teachers - Purchase confirmations - Every message sent in the portal's Messages tab also delivered to the recipient's WhatsApp, with a note and link asking them to reply through the member portal - The Academy will provide business documents and a new WhatsApp number for Meta verification Google Slides and Google Drive for teachers - Slides for the next class available to the assigned teacher only, never to students - Slides released to the teacher automatically - Google Drive managed from inside the portal Social Media tab - A central place in the portal to upload the Academy's social media posts - Platforms: Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X, TikTok, YouTube and LinkedIn Requirements - Proven experience with custom Moodle plugin development, Moodle payment gateways and API integrations (Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business API) - Ability to work with existing custom plugins written by another developer - Moodle-native features or established plugins where possible, with no changes to Moodle core - All work done and tested on staging first. Nothing goes on the live site without my approval. - Clear handover notes for each stage, and all code delivered to a repository owned by the Academy Important: All accounts, code and credentials remain the property of Al Kithab Academy. The developer must not change ownership, recovery details or passwords without written permission. In your proposal, please include: - Your approach for each stage - Your timeframe for each stage - Examples of similar Moodle work, especially custom portals, page customisation tools, payment gateways or WhatsApp integrations - Any ongoing costs we should expect, such as WhatsApp message charges or plugin licences Budget: $55 fixed price for all three stages, released by milestone as each stage is completed and tested: - Stage 1: $15 - Stage 2: $20 - Stage 3: $20 Skills: Moodle, PHP, Payment Gateway Integration, Google APIs, WhatsApp API, Website Design, Security, Linux

Please preserve every highlight, shadow and depth cue so the mark still reads as clearly 3D when printed or displayed flat. I will supply the current logo in its original format as soon as we start.

opportunities.description: Full-Stack Developer Needed: Custom Inventory, POS & Accounting ERP ----- Project Overview: We are looking for an experienced full-stack web developer (or agency) to build a custom, responsive, web-based Inventory, Billing, and Accounting Management System tailored for an Auto Parts Wholesale & Retail business. The system must handle high-volume parts cataloging, barcode scanning, dual-channel invoicing (GST Tax Invoices and Counter/Cash Invoices), inter-branch stock transfers, vendor/customer ledgers, and comprehensive financial/stock reporting. ----- Key Modules & Requirements: 1. Masters & Settings Configuration Catalog Masters: Product Categories, Sub-categories, Car Models compatibility, and Part Manufacturing Companies. Entity Masters: Customer directory, Vendor directory, Staff directory, and Mechanic/Technician profiles (with commission tracking). Location Masters: Warehouses and Warehouse Rack/Shelf locations. Financial & Compliance: Financial Year management, Multi-user roles & permission-based login, Business/Company profile, Bank account details, GST tax rates & HSN, and State codes. 2. Product & Inventory Management Product Catalog: Unique Part Number / SKU, UID, Car Model compatibility, Manufacturer/Company, Category, Sub-category, Rack location, Opening stock, and Reorder/Minimum stock alerts. Barcode Support: Barcode generation, barcode label printing, and instant scanning. Product Views: Detailed product view including images, current stock levels, and historical transaction logs. 3. Purchase Management Purchase Orders & Bills: Vendor selection, bill reference, itemized parts entry with barcode scanning, batch/part numbers, unit rates, and automatic GST calculation (CGST, SGST, IGST). Additional Costs: Packing & forwarding (P/F), transport cost, and vehicle tracking. Purchase Returns: Debit notes/returns management with stock reversals and vendor ledger adjustments. 4. Sales & Invoicing (Dual Channel) Standard Invoices (Tax / With Bill): Complete GST-compliant billing with barcode lookup, sequential auto-numbering, multi-tax tiers, mechanic selection & commission calculations, customer balance tracking, and print/PDF export formats. Invoice C (Cash / Estimate / Counter Bills): Streamlined invoice creation for retail/counter transactions without formal tax billing. Sales Returns: Credit notes handling with automated stock returns and customer balance refunds/adjustments. 5. Inventory Operations & Adjustments Stock Transfers: Inter-branch/shop stock transfer workflows (e.g., Shop 1 to Shop 2) with status tracking. Dead Stock / Write-offs: Marking damaged, obsolete, or unsellable stock. Barcode Generation Module: Bulk generation and printing for existing or incoming unlabeled items. 6. Accounting & Financial Entries Customer Transactions: Journal entries, balance adjustments, payment collection logs (Cash/Bank split). Vendor Transactions: Payments to suppliers, advance tracking, and expense entries. Cash & Bank Management: Unified cash/bank daybook and account reconciliations. 7. Reports & Analytics 8. Mobile Application Requirement A mobile application is also required for the business owner’s personal use. The app should work on Android and iPhone and connect securely to the same central system. Key mobile features: View live dashboards and reports: daily sales, purchases, cash/bank balance, stock value, low-stock items, pending customer balances, vendor balances, profit/loss, and branch-wise performance. Search products and check real-time stock, price, rack location, and transaction history. Create and share invoices directly from the phone, including barcode-based product lookup, customer selection, GST/non-GST invoice options, discounts, payments, and PDF/WhatsApp sharing. View invoice, payment, customer, vendor, and stock-transfer status. Owner-only access or separate mobile permissions with secure login, audit logs, and data protection. Inventory Reports: Opening vs. Closing stock, Minimum/Low stock alerts, Dead stock reports. Sales & Purchase Analytics: Sales report (Bill vs. Non-Bill), Purchase reports, Staff sales, Mechanic sales & commission logs, Packing/Forwarding & Freight cost tracking. Party Ledgers: Detailed Customer Ledgers, Vendor Ledgers, and Outstanding Balance Aging reports. Financial Statements: Profit & Loss statement, Daybook, and GST filing summaries. Audit & Security: User activity logs and audit trail. ----- Technical Expectations: Tech Stack: Modern, fast stack (e.g., React / Next.js / Vue on Frontend; Node.js / Python / Laravel on Backend; PostgreSQL / MariaDB / MySQL). *Please specify your recommended stack. Hardware Integration: Fast USB/Bluetooth barcode scanner integration and thermal/standard printer-friendly invoice templates. Database & Concurrency: ACID compliant, safe concurrent writes, prevent negative inventory unless allowed, and server-side GST tax rounding rules. Responsive UI: Clean, dense, desktop-first UI optimized for fast data entry via keyboard shortcuts. ----- Deliverables: 1. Complete source code repository with clear documentation and setup instructions. 2. Production-ready web app hosted on our server/cloud. 3. Clean, normalized database schema. 4. Testing suite covering critical accounting and stock workflows. ----- How to Apply: When submitting your proposal, please provide: 1. Examples or live demos of relevant ERP, POS, Inventory, or Accounting systems you have built. 2. Your proposed technology stack and database architecture. 3. Your estimated timeline and milestone breakdown. 4. Your fixed-price quote or hourly estimate for the project.

opportunities.title: Python Exam Figure Generator Service
opportunities.description: We publish online mock tests for government exams (SSC, Railway) in English and Hindi. Today our team draws every question figure by hand. We need a Python service that draws them automatically from JSON, so our AI question generator can request a figure for each new question. The full specification is in the attached PDF (Project Brief). Please read it before bidding. BUILT WITH CLAUDE Designed to be completed by one developer using Claude (Claude Code) and free open-source Python libraries only: no paid software, no hand drawing, no external services. The sample zip includes CLAUDE.md (instructions for Claude Code) and PROJECT_SPEC.md (full spec in Markdown). All acceptance checks are automated. WHAT YOU WILL BUILD - A Python 3.10+ renderer: JSON in, clean print-quality SVG and PNG out, in our house style. - The JSON describes meaning, not coordinates ("tangent from P touching at R and S", "all A are B", "triangle with angles 30, 60, 90"). Your code works out every position. This needs real geometry: tangents, inscribed circles, triangles from sides and angles, 3D solids drawn in 2D. - A label placer: no label may ever touch a line, an arc or another label, even in crowded figures. This is checked by an automated test. - English and Hindi (Devanagari) labels, with correct conjunct shaping in SVG and PNG. - A JSON Schema per figure type, with separate errors for invalid input, an impossible figure and an unknown figure type. - Deterministic output: the same input always gives byte-identical files. - A REST API with an API key, packaged with Docker, plus a step-by-step deployment guide. - A JSON input for each of our 525 reference figures, plus a side-by-side review page (our figure next to yours). FIGURE TYPES (525 figures) Reasoning: Direction Sense (60), Non-Verbal Venn (53), Finding Missing Elements (44), Logical Venn (41), Coding-Decoding (37), Seating Arrangement (30), Series (17), Syllogism (14), Classification (3) Quant: Circle (65), Area (38), Volume (34), Triangles (26), Data Interpretation charts (12), Quadrilateral (16), Height & Distance (12), Lines & Angles (11), Coordinate Geometry (10), Mixture (2) 34 sample figures are attached. The full set (with manifest and errata) is shared after award. MILESTONES (quote a price and duration for each) M1 Core system and pilot (134 figures): core engine, label placer, schema framework, API, Docker, review page, test suite + Logical Venn, Non-Verbal Venn, Syllogism, Triangles M2 Reasoning and charts (205 figures): Seating Arrangement, Classification, Direction Sense, Coding-Decoding, Series, Finding Missing Elements, DI charts, Mixture M3 Geometry and handover (186 figures): Lines & Angles, Coordinate Geometry, Circle, Quadrilateral, Height & Distance, Area, Volume, final Docker package and deployment guide M1 is also the pilot. We release M2 and M3 to the same freelancer only if M1 is accepted. ACCEPTANCE Every figure in the milestone approved on the review page, the delivered zip builds with Docker and all tests pass (including the label-clearance and determinism checks), schemas and docs complete. Code is delivered as a zip through Freelancer. Final milestone: the API starts by following your deployment guide. All code and rights transfer to us on payment. No GPL or AGPL dependencies. HOW TO BID Start your proposal with the word FIGURE. Others will not be considered. Please include: 1. Links or screenshots of diagram, geometry or chart rendering you have built in code. 2. How you will keep labels clear of lines (the algorithm). 3. How you will render Devanagari correctly in SVG and PNG. 4. Your Python libraries, and how you will make the output byte-identical. 5. Your price and duration for each milestone, M1 to M3. 6. Confirmation that you accept the pilot-first arrangement. 7. Confirmation that you will build it with Claude Code and free open-source libraries only.

opportunities.title: Tsuba & Menuki CAD Modeling
opportunities.description: I have a pair of AI-generated concept images that show exactly how I want a Japanese sword tsuba and matching menuki to look. Your task is to turn those visuals into clean, manufacture-ready 3D CAD models. • Source material – Two high-resolution reference images (one for the tsuba, one for the menuki) featuring traditional Japanese patterns exactly as I want them carved or embossed. – A dimension sheet with the precise outer, inner, and thickness measurements for both pieces. No need to estimate; just follow the numbers I supply. • Your work – Recreate every motif from the images with faithful detail, ensuring the patterns wrap or flow naturally around each part. – Build solid, watertight models suitable for CNC machining or lost-wax casting. Undercuts, relief depth, and edge fillets must match the functional realities of sword fittings. – Deliver the final geometry in STEP format. You are welcome to work in Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Rhino, or any other software as long as the exported STEP files open cleanly. • Acceptance criteria 1. Geometry passes a solid integrity check (no open edges or self-intersections). 2. All supplied dimensions are held to ±0.05 mm. 3. Decorative features match the reference images when overlaid. 4. I can import the STEP files and immediately generate toolpaths without repair. If revisions are needed to hit these points, I’ll provide concise notes and expect updated files.

opportunities.title: Three-Part Animation Slide Creation - using MAYA software - 1 Day delivery
opportunities.description: Part 1: Your First Animation (Slides 1 - 4) • Slide 1: Intro — Put the module name, your Student Number only (do not use your real name), and state if you are using 3D, 2D, or hand-drawn animation. • Slide 2: The Video Reference — Show pictures of the real-life video (LAV) you copied. Draw arrows on the pictures to show how the person balances and moves. • Slide 3: The Behind-the-Scenes — Take a screenshot of your animation software's graph curves (the Graph Editor). Explain how you adjusted these lines to make the character look heavy, not floaty. • Slide 4: The Final Video — Put your finished 10-second animation clip here. Write a short paragraph explaining what parts look perfect and what parts were hard to do. Part 2: Your Second Animation (Slides 5 - 7) • Slide 5: A New Movement — Pick a completely different movement for your second animation (for example, if the first was a kick, make this one a heavy lift). Show your video reference for it. • Slide 6: Making It Clear — Show your character as a solid black shape (silhouette). This proves your poses are clear and easy to read. • Slide 7: The Final Video — Put your second 10-second animation clip here and write a quick review of it. Part 3: Your Third Animation & Checklist (Slides 8 - 12) • Slide 8: The Hardest Movement — Show your third video reference (something fast or complex, like a jump or a tumble). • Slide 9: Fixing Mistakes — Show a side-by-side picture of your early, messy version versus your finished, clean version. Explain how you fixed a technical problem (like a shaky knee or a glitch). • Slide 10: The Final Video — Put your third 10-second animation clip here. • Slide 11: What You Learned — Create a simple checklist showing how you used animation rules (like Timing and Weight) across all three clips. • Slide 12: The Rules Page — List the websites or books you used for help (using BCU Harvard style). Copy and fill out the AI Form from your assignment brief telling the teacher if you used AI or not.

opportunities.title: Soporte WhatsApp Español Fines Semana

Trabajo con WhatsApp Business, de modo que tendrás acceso al panel web y a plantillas preaprobadas. Me interesa que mantengas un tono cordial, respuestas claras y una velocidad de reacción que no supere los cinco minutos durante el horario de servicio. También agradeceré un pequeño registro al final de cada jornada con número de conversaciones atendidas, dudas frecuentes y cualquier comentario que ayude a mejorar nuestras respuestas automáticas. Si manejas correctamente la ortografía, tienes conexión estable y te sientes cómodo intercambiando mensajes rápidos, este proyecto encaja contigo.

opportunities.title: Health App Website Redesign & Marketing
opportunities.description: Website Revamp for Health App – Healthcare Software Promotion & Lead Generation Project Overview We need a skilled website designer/developer to revamp our existing website: https://thehealthapp.co.in Health App is a complete clinic and hospital management system offering OPD, IPD, EMS, HR & Payroll, Pharmacy, Billing, Finance, Appointments, and Patient Booking. Important: This is an introductory and promotional website, not the actual hospital management software. Its purpose is to showcase our product features, attract hospital and clinic owners, and connect potential customers with us for free demos and subscriptions. Tagline: Health App – Make Healthcare Online Brand Message: Smart, Paperless & Connected Healthcare Objectives * Create a modern, professional healthcare technology website. * Explain our software features and benefits. * Generate genuine hospital and clinic leads. * Encourage visitors to book a free demo. * Integrate WhatsApp, phone calls, and enquiry forms. * Improve mobile responsiveness, website speed, and SEO. * Make website content easy to update. Design Requirements * Premium, clean design with white, teal, and blue colours matching our existing logo. * Professional typography, intuitive navigation, and clear CTAs. * Relevant Indian healthcare visuals and genuine product screenshots. * Responsive layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop. * Fast loading, subtle animations, and consistent branding. Avoid clutter, excessive animations, generic templates, and fabricated application screens. Required Pages and Features 1. Homepage Headline: Manage Your Entire Hospital with One Smart Digital Platform Explain how Health App simplifies hospital operations. Include an introduction, key benefits, module overview, product screenshots/videos, how it works, FAQs, and contact details. Primary buttons: Book a Free Demo | Contact Us on WhatsApp 2. OPD Management Showcase online appointments, digital tokens, queue management, running token, live patient token status, waiting-time estimates, doctor availability, future-date booking, prescriptions, and billing. Explain how online and offline consultations can use a common doctor queue. 3. IPD Management Showcase patient admission, floor/room/bed availability, doctor assignment, prescription and treatment tracking, medicine and service charges, inpatient billing, discharge advice, and supported paperless workflows. Do not advertise unavailable laboratory or radiology features. 4. EMS, HR & Payroll Explain employee records, departments, attendance punch-in/punch-out, working-hour tracking, payroll generation based on configured rules, and payroll integration with Finance. 5. Pharmacy and Inventory Explain available medicine records, stock management, and billing integration where supported. Use genuine screenshots. 6. Billing and Finance Highlight OPD/IPD billing, medicine and service charges, prescription and final bill printouts, applicable GST handling, expense management, cash tracking, transaction records, and payroll integration. Identify optional or subscription-dependent features accurately. 7. Appointments and Patient Booking Explain online pre-booking, doctor availability, appointment scheduling, live token tracking, and waiting-time visibility. 8. About Us Introduce Health App, our mission, and our focus on practical, connected, and paperless healthcare management. 9. Contact Us / Book a Free Demo Create a short, mobile-friendly form with hospital name, contact person, phone, email, city, facility type, interested modules, and preferred demo time. Send enquiries to our designated business email or an agreed lead-management destination. Show a confirmation message after successful submission. 10. Pricing / Subscription Enquiry Provide a flexible section with “Request Pricing” and “Book a Free Demo” buttons. Do not invent prices or subscription terms. Lead Generation Implement: * Prominent demo buttons across pages. * Floating WhatsApp button and mobile click-to-call. * Functional enquiry forms with confirmation messages. * Spam protection and privacy disclosures. * Google Analytics and Meta Pixel, if agreed and authorised. Test all forms and contact links to ensure enquiries reach us. Screenshots and Promotional Content We can provide our logo, product screenshots, and product information. Display genuine screenshots professionally, use device mockups where appropriate, and integrate supplied promotional videos. Do not fabricate screens or advertise unavailable functionality. SEO Requirements Implement page titles, meta descriptions, proper headings, descriptive URLs, image alt text, internal links, XML sitemap, robots.txt, and basic technical SEO. Target relevant Indian keywords such as hospital management software, clinic management software, OPD management, IPD management, and hospital billing. Assist with Google Search Console if access is provided. Technical Requirements * Preserve our existing domain: https://thehealthapp.co.in * Audit and back up the existing website before major changes. * Maintain existing functionality unless changes are approved. * Use a secure, responsive, maintainable technology stack. * Optimise loading speed and Core Web Vitals. * Provide easy content editing. * Configure redirects if URLs change. * Test major browsers and devices. * Avoid unnecessary paid plugins and subscriptions. * Do not change the live website without approval. Disclose the technology stack, hosting requirements, recurring costs, and paid dependencies before starting. Deliverables 1. Website audit and revamp plan. 2. Approved homepage design. 3. Completed responsive promotional website. 4. Agreed module pages/sections. 5. Functional enquiry forms. 6. WhatsApp and click-to-call integration. 7. Basic SEO and agreed analytics. 8. Mobile, tablet, and desktop testing. 9. Performance and security checks. 10. Deployment to our existing domain. 11. Complete source code and project-specific design files. 12. Admin/content-editing access, where applicable. 13. Handover documentation and agreed post-launch bug support. Budget and Timeline Preferred budget: Under ₹10,000 INR. Please specify your fixed price, delivery timeline, included revisions, hosting and third-party costs, support duration, and exclusions. If the complete scope exceeds the budget, propose a phased approach prioritising the homepage, module information, genuine screenshots, demo forms, WhatsApp, mobile responsiveness, and SEO. Freelancer Qualifications Experience in SaaS/business website design, UI/UX, responsive development, SEO, performance optimisation, and lead generation is preferred. Healthcare software experience is an advantage. Application Questions 1. Share three relevant website projects. 2. What technology stack do you recommend and why? 3. Can you complete the agreed scope within ₹10,000? 4. What is your estimated timeline? 5. Will you provide source code and admin access? 6. What post-launch support is included? 7. Are there recurring costs or paid plugins? Important: Review https://thehealthapp.co.in before quoting. Our goal: Build a professional website that showcases Health App’s capabilities and converts visitors into genuine hospital and clinic demo enquiries. This project is for promoting our existing software and connecting leads with us, not developing the software itself.

Before I roll these items out to my other storefronts, I need every product attribute brought into line—titles, variants, options, tags, metafields, SEO handles, anything that drives consistency across collections and search. Once the master data is clean, the finished catalogue must be copied into my additional Shopify stores so each one launches with identical, error-free information. opportunities.title: Interactive 3D Room Planner & Furniture Configurator Developer (Three.js / WebGL)
opportunities.description: I want to launch a browser-based room planner that feels as fluid as a native design tool. Visitors will be able to start from either a predefined room template or enter their own dimensions, then drag-and-drop furniture, rotate and resize it, and swap materials or colours on the fly. Walls, floors, and entire furniture sets must respond instantly to changes so the customer always sees a true-to-life preview. I have chosen the Three.js / React Three Fiber stack because I need WebGL performance without sacrificing React’s component model. Smooth camera controls, accurate collision detection, and real-time lighting are all essential to keep the experience realistic and engaging. Core requirements • Dual room setup: selectable templates plus fully custom width, depth, and height input. • Full style palette: wall colour & texture, flooring options, and multiple furniture styles available through a JSON-driven catalogue. • Object interactions: drag & drop placement, freeform rotation, uniform and non-uniform scaling, plus dynamic material swapping. • Optimised loading: progressive asset streaming so large models never block interaction. • State export: user designs must save to JSON for later editing or to generate a branded PDF snapshot. Acceptance criteria 1. A responsive web app that runs smoothly on modern desktop and mobile browsers (60 fps on mid-range hardware). 2. No visible artefacts when switching materials; PBR textures should update in real time. 3. All transformations respect room boundaries, with snap-to-wall and grid options. 4. Clean, documented React components and modular Three.js helpers ready for hand-off to my internal team. If you have shipped similar product configurators or architectural visualisers, I would love to review a live link or repo. Let’s build a planner that shoppers will actually enjoy using.

opportunities.title: Expert 3D Artist for Roblox Avatar Assets
opportunities.description: We’re looking for a 3D artist with proven experience working on Roblox Marketplace-ready avatar assets. We’re open to different areas of specialization across the Roblox avatar ecosystem. You do not need to cover every category or handle the entire pipeline yourself. What matters most is that you have previously made or contributed to Roblox assets intended to be Marketplace-ready, understand the technical expectations behind that work, and can clearly show what you personally handled. RELEVANT ROBLOX EXPERIENCE MAY INCLUDE Avatar Bundles R15 bundles, custom avatar bodies, heads, Dynamic Heads, and related avatar components. Clothing Shirts, jackets, pants, shorts, skirts, dresses, shoes, layered clothing, and classic / 2D clothing. Accessories Hair, head, face, eyebrows, eyelashes, front, neck, shoulder, back, waist, left/right gear, and other rigid accessories. Experience in any one of these areas can be relevant. We’re ideally looking for someone who can show at least two examples within one or more of the areas above, so we can see that the workflow is something you’ve handled repeatedly rather than only once. RELEVANT PRODUCTION EXPERIENCE MAY INCLUDE Depending on the project and your specialization, useful experience may include: - Retopology and optimization - UV preparation - High-poly to low-poly baking - Skinning / rigging - Inner and outer cages - Attachments - Roblox Studio integration / validation - Marketplace preparation - Working within Roblox asset-specific technical limits and requirements Depending on your strengths, the production pipeline may be divided between multiple artists rather than expecting one person to own everything end-to-end. SOFTWARE Blender is preferred, but we’re also open to artists working in Maya. ROBLOX MARKETPLACE KNOWLEDGE We’re specifically looking for someone familiar with creating assets intended for Roblox Marketplace publishing, rather than general Roblox-style modeling alone. Having personally taken an asset through Roblox Studio validation or Marketplace publishing is a strong plus, but it is not mandatory if you can demonstrate meaningful production work on Marketplace-ready assets. PORTFOLIO / PROOF OF WORK Please share examples of your Roblox-specific work. We’re especially interested in seeing some proof of how the assets were made, not only final renders. Useful examples may include: - Wireframes / topology - High-poly and low-poly comparisons - Cage setups - Skinning or rigging - Bake results - Blender or Maya screenshots - Roblox Studio testing - Marketplace listings - Work-in-progress or behind-the-scenes videos WHEN APPLYING, PLEASE INCLUDE: 1. Which Roblox avatar asset categories have you worked on, and were those assets intended for the Roblox Marketplace? Please specify your experience with bundles, bodies, heads, clothing, or accessories. 2. Share at least two relevant Roblox asset examples and explain exactly what you personally handled on each. Include any available Marketplace links, wireframes, cages, rigging, bake results, or production screenshots. 3. For one of those examples, what technical requirements did you need to meet, and how did you check that the asset met them? If someone else handled Roblox Studio validation or publishing, please clarify your role. 4. Which software do you primarily use, and which production stages can you confidently handle independently? Please also identify any stages you would need another artist to handle. The final scope, pricing, and payment structure will be discussed and agreed before work begins. If your experience looks like a good fit, we’ll share the specific project scope, asset requirements, and production details during the next step.

opportunities.title: Captivating SCCI Membership Promotional Video
opportunities.description: Project Title Create a Professional & Inspiring Promotional Video for Sanand Chamber of Commerce and Industries (SCCI) Project Description We are looking for a highly creative and experienced video production professional to create a powerful, engaging, and premium-quality promotional video for the Sanand Chamber of Commerce and Industries (SCCI), Gujarat, India. About SCCI: Sanand Chamber of Commerce and Industries represents businesses, manufacturers, MSMEs, entrepreneurs, and industries operating in the Sanand region. SCCI aims to unite the industrial community, promote business growth, strengthen industry collaboration, and act as a bridge between industries and government authorities. Video Objective Our primary objective is to encourage business owners, industrialists, manufacturers, and entrepreneurs operating in Sanand Taluka to become members of SCCI. The video should communicate one strong message: "If you are running a business in Sanand, become part of a stronger, united industrial community. Join SCCI." Key Messages to Highlight - Unity and collective strength of industries. - A strong platform representing the industrial community. - A bridge between businesses and government authorities. - Networking and new business opportunities. - Collective representation of industrial challenges. - Growth and development of the Sanand industrial ecosystem. - Encouraging every business operating in Sanand Taluka to join SCCI. Video Requirements - Duration: 60–90 seconds. - Language: English only. - Style: Corporate, cinematic, inspiring, modern, and professional. - Visuals: High-quality industrial footage, manufacturing facilities, business meetings, industrial infrastructure, entrepreneurs, and Sanand's industrial development. - AI-generated visuals may be used, provided they look realistic and professional. - Strong storytelling with an engaging opening and memorable conclusion. - Professional English voice-over. - Suitable background music, motion graphics, and smooth transitions. - SCCI's original logo must be used without alteration. - Video should conclude with a compelling "Join SCCI Today" call to action. Expected Deliverables 1. Creative video concept and complete script. 2. Storyboard for approval. 3. Professional voice-over and background music. 4. Fully edited promotional video in Full HD or 4K. 5. Vertical version (9:16) for Instagram Reels, Facebook, and WhatsApp. 6. Horizontal version (16:9) for YouTube, presentations, and events. 7. Final editable project/source files. 8. Commercial usage rights for all included footage, music, graphics, and other assets. Important We do not want a generic slideshow or basic promotional video. We are looking for an emotionally engaging, visually impressive corporate film that inspires business owners to feel proud of Sanand's industrial community and motivates them to become SCCI members. The final video must look premium, authentic, and suitable for representing a professional industrial chamber. Freelancer Selection Criteria Please share: - Your portfolio of corporate or promotional videos. - Examples of cinematic industrial or business videos. - Your proposed creative approach. - Your estimated completion timeline. - Your fixed-price quotation. Preference will be given to freelancers who can combine strong storytelling, realistic industrial visuals, premium editing, and professional voice-over. Our Vision: One Industrial Community. One Stronger Voice. One Better Future. Join Sanand Chamber of Commerce and Industries (SCCI).

opportunities.title: Remote Business Development & Sales Executive
opportunities.description: # Business Development & Sales Executive **JACKS Premium Medical Apparel** **Industry:** Healthcare Apparel | Medical Fashion | B2B Sales **Location:** Remote — U.S. Market Focus **Employment Type:** Part-Time, With Full-Time Growth Opportunities ## About JACKS Premium Medical Apparel JACKS Premium Medical Apparel is a physician-founded premium medical apparel brand dedicated to redefining comfort, style, functionality, and professionalism in healthcare. Our vision is to build a nationally recognized, multimillion-dollar medical apparel company serving healthcare professionals, educational institutions, hospitals, and healthcare organizations across the United States. We are seeking a highly motivated, articulate, and results-driven Business Development & Sales Executive who can independently generate leads, establish institutional partnerships, acquire customers, and close sales. This is a revenue-generating position, not simply an administrative or social media management role. ## Key Responsibilities ### 1. Business Development & Institutional Sales - Identify and contact nursing schools, medical schools, allied health training programs, home health agencies, hospice companies, hospitals, medical practices, and healthcare staffing agencies. - Establish relationships with purchasing managers, school administrators, business owners, and healthcare executives. - Present JACKS medical apparel, institutional pricing, bulk purchasing opportunities, and discount programs. - Negotiate within approved pricing guidelines and independently close individual and institutional sales. - Develop long-term vendor relationships and secure repeat purchasing agreements. - Schedule qualified business meetings with the founder for major contracts and strategic partnerships. ### 2. Sales Outreach & Customer Acquisition - Conduct outbound telephone calls, cold emails, LinkedIn outreach, and direct social media messaging. - Identify potential customers and institutional purchasing opportunities. - Deliver concise, persuasive sales presentations that capture attention within the first 30–60 seconds. - Handle customer objections, follow up consistently, and convert prospects into paying customers. - Maintain an organized sales pipeline and track customer interactions using CRM software. ### 3. Social Media Marketing & Customer Service - Manage customer engagement across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and other digital platforms. - Contact physicians, nurses, medical students, and allied health professionals to introduce JACKS products. - Promote exclusive discounts, referral programs, and brand ambassador opportunities. - Respond promptly to product inquiries, sizing questions, order requests, and customer concerns. - Support content scheduling, influencer collaborations, and brand awareness initiatives. ### 4. Executive & Administrative Support - Provide occasional executive assistance to the founder. - Coordinate Zoom meetings with qualified business prospects and institutional decision-makers. - Prepare sales proposals, business correspondence, and meeting summaries. - Assist with order coordination, customer records, and follow-up communications. - Submit weekly reports detailing sales activity, leads, conversions, meetings, and revenue generated. ## Required Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, healthcare, communications, or a related field; equivalent demonstrated sales success may be considered. - Minimum 2 years of experience in sales, business development, customer acquisition, or account management. - Demonstrated ability to prospect, negotiate, overcome objections, and close sales. - **Excellent written and spoken English**, with clear pronunciation, professional telephone etiquette, and strong familiarity with U.S. business communication. - Strong interpersonal, negotiation, persuasion, and relationship-building skills. - Experience communicating with business owners, executives, purchasing managers, or institutional decision-makers. - Familiarity with healthcare apparel, medical scrubs, healthcare products, or the U.S. healthcare industry. - Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, CRM software, and social media platforms. - Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver measurable results with minimal supervision. - Availability to conduct business outreach during U.S. business hours. ## Preferred Qualifications **Candidates with medical or healthcare backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.** Preference will be given to candidates with: - Medical, nursing, or allied health education or professional experience. - Experience selling healthcare products, medical apparel, or medical supplies. - Previous B2B sales experience with hospitals, nursing schools, home health agencies, hospice organizations, or healthcare institutions. - Established professional relationships within the U.S. healthcare industry. - Experience with Shopify, e-commerce sales, and digital customer acquisition. - A proven track record of meeting sales targets and securing business partnerships. Medical students and healthcare professionals with demonstrated sales and communication skills are welcome to apply. ## Key Performance Expectations The successful candidate will be evaluated on: - Qualified business leads generated. - Healthcare institutions and decision-makers contacted. - Sales meetings scheduled and completed. - Customer acquisition and conversion rates. - Individual and institutional orders closed. - Revenue generated and repeat customer purchases. - Institutional partnerships established. - Customer satisfaction and follow-up performance. ## Ideal Candidate We are looking for a confident, persuasive, proactive professional who is comfortable initiating conversations, building relationships, and closing deals. The ideal candidate is: -Five nonnegotiable hiring criteria 1. Excellent American-market English communication: Clear pronunciation, fluent conversational English, and professional telephone etiquette. An American accent itself should not be required. 2. Proven closing ability: At least two years of outbound sales experience, ideally with U.S. customers. 3. Healthcare knowledge: Familiarity with scrubs, nursing schools, home health agencies, hospice organizations, or healthcare purchasing. 4. Confident and persistent: Able to reach decision-makers, overcome objections, and ask for the sale without being pushy or disrespectful. 5. Independent execution: Can identify prospects, make calls, follow up, negotiate within approved limits, and close routine orders without requiring your constant involvement. **This position is ideal for someone who wants to play a meaningful role in scaling an emerging healthcare apparel brand into a nationally recognized business.** ## Our Vision At JACKS Premium Medical Apparel, we are building more than a clothing company. We are creating a premium medical apparel brand that combines professional identity, innovation, comfort, and sophisticated design. We are seeking a professional who can help turn that vision into measurable business growth through customer acquisition, strategic partnerships, and revenue generation. **JACKS Premium Medical Apparel** *Cut From a Different Cloth.* **Website:** https://liveinjacks.myshopify.com/

opportunities.title: Shopify Conversion Audit & Optimization
opportunities.description: ## Shopify Conversion Specialist Needed — Audit + Implementation Storm Wellness receives website traffic and add-to-carts, but very few customers complete checkout. We need a Shopify CRO specialist to identify the conversion barriers and implement the fixes. ### Primary objective Improve conversion from: **Product page → Add to cart → Checkout → Purchase** ### Work required - Audit the mobile product page, cart and checkout. - Analyse price, bundles, shipping charges and offer presentation. - Fix trust, offer and checkout friction. - Improve product-page copy, reviews, guarantees, COD and delivery visibility. - Simplify CTAs and make the best-value bundle clear. - Test prepaid and COD orders. - Verify Meta Pixel/CAPI Purchase tracking. - Implement WhatsApp/email abandoned-cart recovery. - Implement all agreed changes—not audit only. ### Deliverables - Written conversion diagnosis. - Changes implemented on Shopify. - Working prepaid and COD checkout. - Correct Purchase event with INR value. - Before/after funnel report. - Seven days of bug support. ### Current issue - Traffic and add-to-carts are coming. - Very few initiate checkout. - Completed purchases are extremely low. - Average shipping cost is approximately ₹200. - Website currently runs a 10% discount. - Most traffic is from mobile devices. ### Budget and timeline - Fixed project: ₹3000-4000 - Timeline: 7–10 days. - Please apply only if you have improved conversions for Shopify/D2C brands and can implement the changes yourself. Share two relevant examples, your fixed quote and your expected timeline. page - https://www.stormwellnesshub.com/products/storm-hydrate-electrolyte-powder-sachets-salted-lemon-700mg-sodium-260mg-potassium-90mg-magnesium-rapid-hydration-drink-mix-for-workout-gym-summer-heat-10-sachets-x-8g

opportunities.title: Web Application Functional & Performance Testing
opportunities.description: I have a browser-based product that is feature-complete but still unproven in the wild. Before I release it, I need a meticulous round of software testing that covers two fronts: • Functional testing – confirm every user flow behaves as designed, edge-cases are handled gracefully, and regression risks are caught early. • Performance testing – measure load times, stress the API, identify bottlenecks, and tell me exactly how many concurrent users the current build can support before degradation shows. You are free to choose the right tools; Selenium or Playwright for functional automation and JMeter, Gatling, or similar for the load work make sense, but I am open to other suggestions if you can justify them. Please provide the following deliverables: 1. A concise test plan outlining scenarios, data sets, and tooling. 2. Executed test cases with pass/fail evidence (screenshots, logs, HAR files where relevant). 3. A performance report summarising methodology, metrics, graphs, and clear recommendations. 4. A prioritised defect list with reproduction steps and severity ratings. All findings should be reproducible on a clean environment and traceable back to the original requirement or user story. I can spin up a fresh staging server for you and will supply credentials and API keys once we agree to start.

opportunities.title: Triple-Filter Stainless Bottle Prototype
opportunities.description: I am developing an ergonomic stainless-steel water bottle that houses a three-stage filtration system—sediment, activated carbon, and a resin layer—and need an engineer or industrial designer to turn the concept into a production-ready prototype. The brief • Bottle body, cap, and any internal hardware must be food-grade 304/316 stainless steel. • Filters slot in sequentially and can be replaced individually; overall filter cartridge should remain under 60 mm in length so the bottle keeps a comfortable handhold. • Form factor must feel ergonomic for daily carry but avoid odd curves that complicate CNC or hydroforming. Think sleek taper, good grip points, and a capacity of roughly 600–700 ml. • Proof-of-concept only, yet tolerances, sealing surfaces, and assembly steps should already anticipate mass production. What I expect from you 1. 3D CAD files (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or STEP) showing the bottle, cap, seal, and modular filter assembly. 2. Basic FEA or wall-thickness justification so we know it survives a drop test. 3. Exploded renderings and a concise BOM noting stainless grades, filter media specs, and gasket materials. 4. Guidance on prototype manufacturing—recommended processes, estimated tooling, and any critical QC checks for the filter stages. Acceptance criteria • Assembled unit passes a leak test at 1 bar for 5 minutes. • Filter cartridge can be swapped without tools in under 15 seconds. • Overall weight stays below 450 g empty. If you’ve designed drinkware or inline filters before, please share examples or quick sketches so I can gauge fit. Let’s get this prototype right the first time and pave the way to full-scale production.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40777553, publicado hace 6 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: AUD 250 - 750.

Its architecture is suitable for developing a comprehensive collection of mathematical calculators, scientific tools, financial calculators, and unit converters covering categories such as length, area, temperature, weight, volume, speed, and more. The platform can be expanded with dedicated tool pages, educational guides, helpful articles, and SEO-focused content to grow its reach through organic search. The website offers potential for further development into a larger online utility platform, with possible monetization opportunities through display advertising, relevant affiliate partnerships, and other suitable revenue models, subject to implementation and applicable platform policies. Its lightweight approach is well suited to tools that perform calculations directly in the browser without requiring user accounts or a database for core functionality. opportunities.title: Admin Komentar Instagram Kreatif
opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan seorang admin yang mampu menangani komentar di akun Instagram saya. Fokus utamanya adalah sosial media, jadi saya butuh Anda sigap memantau setiap notifikasi, menanggapi komentar dengan bahasa yang sopan namun tetap kreatif, dan menjaga suasana diskusi tetap positif. Tugas utama: • Memantau komentar baru setiap hari dan merespons maksimal dalam satu jam sejak muncul. • Menyusun balasan yang ringkas, ramah, serta relevan dengan gambar atau caption. • Menyaring komentar negatif—laporkan, sembunyikan, atau tanggapi secara profesional sesuai panduan yang saya berikan. • Merangkum insight mingguan: topik hangat, pertanyaan berulang, serta saran pengikut. Keahlian yang saya harapkan: • Paham budaya Instagram, tren hashtag, dan gaya bahasa warganet Indonesia. • Penulisan cepat dan bebas typo. • Kreatif mencari cara menghidupkan interaksi tanpa terkesan bot. • Pengalaman moderasi atau customer engagement menjadi nilai tambah. Berikan contoh singkat (maks 2–3 kalimat) tentang cara Anda merespons komentar biasa, kritik, dan pertanyaan produk. Saya akan memilih freelancer yang balasannya terasa natural sekaligus membantu.

opportunities.title: Aerospace Concept Illustrator Required
opportunities.description: I'm looking for a freelancer to create three illustrations explaining how the product is used. The priority is clarity: the illustrations should make it easy to understand the product, its deployment, and its intended use. I'm open to the freelancer's suggestions on the most suitable visual style. Photorealism and detailed engineering models are not required. Scope of work Image 1 — Deployment on land and at sea One composite illustration showing two scenarios: - The V1 system deployed from a launch station at a critical infrastructure site on land. - The V1 system deployed from a launch station on a cargo ship. Image 2 — Mobile deployment An illustration showing the V1 system deployed from a launch station mounted on an unmanned ground vehicle (UGV), supporting troops during a field operation. Image 3 — V2 concept of use An illustration showing the V2 system in a conceptual scenario involving a jet-powered target. Product overview The concept consists of two drone versions, each with its own launch station: - V1: Electrically powered drone. - V2: Jet-powered drone. I will provide detailed descriptions, reference images, and further information about the products and their intended use once the project begins. Deliverables - Three clear, consistent illustrations suitable for a presentation to potential investors and funding bodies. - Simple environments and objects as needed to communicate each scenario. - Final images in PNG or JPG format. - Editable source files, preferably Blender files. - Revisions to ensure the illustrations accurately represent the concepts. Ideal freelancer - Experience with Blender or similar 3D software. - Experience creating product visualizations, concept illustrations, technical graphics, or 3D scenes. - Able to translate written descriptions and references into clear visual explanations. - Able to recommend the most appropriate visual approach for the project. Budget Please provide a fixed-price quote for the three illustrations and examples of relevant previous work. I'm looking for a cost-effective solution focused on communicating the concept clearly, rather than producing high-end CGI.

opportunities.title: Asistente Administrativa Gestión Integral
opportunities.description: Busco apoyo remoto para mantener mi operación diaria organizada y sin sobresaltos. El trabajo gira en torno a tres frentes muy concretos: • Gestión de correos: filtrar, priorizar y responder mensajes de clientes, del equipo interno y de proveedores, dejando claras etiquetas y seguimientos en Gmail/Outlook. • Coordinación de agenda: agendar reuniones, reprogramar citas y prevenir solapamientos en Google Calendar y Outlook, notificando a las partes implicadas con antelación. • Registro de datos: actualizar hojas de cálculo, pequeños reportes y archivos compartidos en Excel / Sheets, asegurando exactitud y formato uniforme. Para desenvolverte con soltura necesitarás dominio cotidiano de Microsoft Office Suite y Google Workspace. Entrego acceso a las cuentas, reglas de clasificación de correo y un calendario maestro; espero a cambio bandeja al día, citas confirmadas y bases de datos impecables. Valoro respuestas ágiles (dentro de la jornada) y atención al detalle: errores mínimos y comunicación clara cuando surjan dudas. Si te encanta organizar, sabes priorizar y disfrutas manteniendo todo en orden, me encantará contar contigo.

opportunities.title: Industrial Processing Machine Design Required
opportunities.description: I need a complete mechanical design for a new piece of industrial machinery that will perform a dedicated processing operation within my production line. The end goal is a set of detailed, fabrication-ready drawings and supporting documentation that a local workshop can take straight to the shop floor. Scope of work 1. Machine Design 2. Machine Assembly Video 3. Machine part Disassembly video 4. Machine part 2D and 3D Step File. 5. Machine part BOM. 6. PART COLOR COMBINATIONS 7. MOTOR STRENGTH & POWER JUSTIFICATION 8. REQUIRED GEAR BOX CALCULATION Preferred tools SolidWorks or Inventor for modelling and exploded views, and AutoCAD or native DWG/DXF for the final dimensioned drawings. If you normally run simulations in ANSYS or similar, that’s a plus. Deliverables • 3-D model with all assemblies and sub-assemblies • 2-D fabrication drawings with tolerances, surface finishes, and weld symbols • Basic load, stress, or motion analysis output to justify critical design decisions • Bill of Materials listing every purchased part and raw stock • Assembly and maintenance guidelines so my technicians can commission the machine confidently Acceptance criteria The design must meet the provided process parameters, fit inside the specified footprint, and comply with standard industrial safety regulations (ISO/CE where applicable). All files must open without errors in the stated software versions. Timeline is flexible in the early concept stage, but once we lock the layout I’ll need the full drawing package within four weeks so purchasing can stay on schedule. Let me know what information you need first and your estimated lead time for the initial concept.

opportunities.title: School Outreach & Telecalling Professional Needed
opportunities.description: Freelancer Required – School Outreach & Telecalling Brand: Smart Money for Teens Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu Engagement: Freelance / Part-time Initial duration: 2 weeks About Us Smart Money for Teens provides personal finance education to teenagers, helping them develop practical money-management skills, including budgeting, saving, financial decision-making and online money safety. We are looking for a proactive freelancer who can connect with schools and help us introduce our online financial literacy webinar. Key Responsibilities - Identify and prepare a database of schools in Chennai. - Find the appropriate decision-makers, such as principals, school correspondents, administrators and activity coordinators. - Contact schools directly by phone to introduce our programme. - Explain the benefits of financial literacy education for students. - Share our webinar proposal with interested schools via email or WhatsApp. - Follow up with interested contacts and arrange meetings or webinar bookings. - Maintain a spreadsheet of calls, responses, follow-ups and conversions. - Provide regular progress reports. About the Webinar - Topic: Personal Finance & Financial Literacy for Teenagers - Format: Live online webinar - Duration: 60 minutes - Target customers: Schools in Chennai - Pricing: ₹3,000–₹5,000 per school per session Ideal Candidate - Experience in telecalling, B2B sales, lead generation or educational sales. - Experience contacting schools or educational institutions is preferred. - Good communication and persuasive follow-up skills. - Comfortable speaking with school administrators and decision-makers. - Able to work independently and maintain accurate records. Initial Assignment We plan to begin with a 2-week paid pilot. The freelancer will be responsible for school research, direct calling, follow-ups and generating qualified school leads. Performance will be evaluated based on decision-makers reached, interested schools, meetings arranged and paid webinar bookings. How to Apply Please share: 1. Your relevant experience in school outreach or B2B telecalling. 2. Whether you can build the school database or need one provided. 3. Your proposed fee for the 2-week pilot. 4. Your estimated calling capacity and approach to generating qualified leads. 5. Any relevant previous results or references.

opportunities.title: Residential Cabinetry Drafter Needed
opportunities.description: We are looking for an experienced residential cabinetry and joinery drafter who is highly skilled in both PYTHA 3D CAD and Alphacam. The work will involve drafting residential cabinetry and custom joinery, including kitchens, laundries, wardrobes, bathroom vanities, entertainment units and other custom residential projects. We are looking for someone who can work efficiently, produce accurate drawings and CNC-ready manufacturing files, and communicate well with our team. Requirements: * Strong experience using both PYTHA and Alphacam * Experience drafting residential cabinetry and custom joinery * Ability to interpret architectural plans and measurements * Strong understanding of cabinetry construction, hardware and CNC machining * Ability to work quickly and accurately without constant supervision * Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal * Ability to communicate clearly, ask questions when required and provide regular progress updates * Reliable, organised and able to meet deadlines Efficiency is a major priority. We need someone who is experienced enough to complete straightforward drafting tasks within reasonable timeframes while maintaining a high standard of accuracy. Long-Term Opportunity We are initially looking to bring someone on for ongoing work, with the potential to move into a full-time position. We want someone who can become a reliable part of our team rather than just completing occasional projects. We would like to arrange an initial video call with suitable applicants, followed by a paid drafting trial to assess their experience, speed, accuracy and communication. When applying, please provide: * Your experience with PYTHA and Alphacam * Examples of previous residential joinery projects * Your hourly rate and full-time salary expectations * Your availability and working hours * Your English communication proficiency * Whether you are interested in a long-term, full-time position We are looking for someone experienced, reliable and efficient who can grow with our business.

opportunities.title: Full-Time Remote Joinery Drafter
opportunities.description: Remote Joinery Drafter / PYTHA Designer – CNC Production Files (Full-Time) Job Title: Experienced Retail Joinery Drafter – PYTHA + AlphaCAM CNC Programming About the Role We are an Australian cabinetmaking and commercial joinery business looking for an experienced remote joinery drafter to join our team on a full-time basis. The role involves producing accurate shop drawings, detailed joinery designs and production-ready CNC files for retail joinery, shopfitting, cabinetry and custom commercial projects. You will work remotely with our Australian team, taking project drawings and concepts through to completed manufacturing files ready for production in our workshop. Key Responsibilities * Produce detailed 3D joinery models and shop drawings using PYTHA. * Interpret architectural drawings, plans, elevations and joinery details. * Prepare accurate cutting lists, panel sizes and material specifications. * Generate CNC-ready files using AlphaCAM. * Nest and optimise sheet materials to minimise waste. * Program cabinets, counters, retail displays, curved joinery and custom shopfitting components. * Apply correct toolpaths, drilling patterns, routing operations and machining allowances. * Ensure all files are accurate and ready for manufacturing. * Coordinate with our Australian team to clarify drawings and resolve production issues. * Revise drawings and CNC files when project changes are required. Required Skills and Experience * Strong, proven experience using PYTHA for commercial joinery and cabinetry. * Experience with AlphaCAM CNC programming. * Experience producing production-ready CNC files, not just 3D models or presentation drawings. * Understanding of cabinet construction, joinery methods, board thicknesses, edging and hardware. * Experience with nesting CNC routers and sheet processing. * Ability to read and interpret Australian architectural and shopfitting drawings. * Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently. * Good English communication skills and reliable internet access. CNC Machine and Software Workflow Our workshop uses a 2016 Woodtron Advance Auto Label CNC with automatic loading/unloading and a pre-label station. Our intended software workflow is: PYTHA → AlphaCAM → CNC-ready machine files You must be able to prepare files suitable for our actual Woodtron machine and controller configuration. Experience with Woodtron machines or similar industrial nesting CNC routers is highly regarded. Applicants must be willing to help verify the correct post-processor, file format, tool configuration and machining workflow before production files are approved. Employment Arrangement * Position: Full-time remote contractor or employee, depending on arrangement. * Location: Worldwide; applicants can work from any country. * Budget: A$15–25 per hour, depending on skills and experience. * Hours: Approximately 38–40 hours per week, subject to agreement. * Work: Ongoing projects for the right candidate. * Communication: Regular communication with our Australian workshop and management team. How to Apply Please include the following in your application: 1. Your years of experience using PYTHA. 2. Your experience with AlphaCAM and CNC programming. 3. Examples of retail joinery or shopfitting projects you have completed. 4. Examples of production drawings and CNC-ready files you have prepared. 5. The CNC machines and controllers you have programmed for. 6. Whether you have worked with Woodtron CNC machines before. 7. Your hourly rate in Australian dollars. 8. Your availability for full-time ongoing work. Practical skills test: Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a small sample joinery project, including a production drawing, cutting list and CNC output. The test will be agreed upon in advance. We are looking for someone who understands how joinery is actually manufactured and can take a project from drawings through to accurate, machine-ready production files. Please apply only if you have genuine PYTHA and CNC production experience.

opportunities.title: Stylish Responsive Frontend Revamp
opportunities.description: My current HTML / CSS interface works, but it feels dated, loads slower than it should, and struggles on smaller screens. I want it elevated on three fronts at once: fresh design, leaner performance, and a fluid, fully responsive layout. Design improvements • Modernize the overall look and feel without reinventing the brand core. • Introduce tasteful new visual elements—subtle animations, icons, or micro-interactions—to make the pages more engaging. • Rework typography and spacing so headings, body copy, and white space read cleanly on desktop, tablet, and mobile. Performance optimisation • Reduce first-paint and total load times. • Optimise all images and other static assets (next-gen formats, proper compression, lazy-loading where appropriate). • Minimise and organise CSS/HTML (and any light JS) so the codebase stays readable yet compact. Responsive development Every screen size from large desktop to small phone must render perfectly. Media queries are already in place but need refinement; grids, flexbox, and fluid units should replace hard-coded dimensions where sensible. Deliverables 1. Updated HTML/CSS (and any supporting files) ready to drop into my existing codebase. 2. Before-and-after Lighthouse or WebPageTest benchmarks proving faster load and smaller bundle size. 3. A brief hand-off note summarising changes, class naming conventions, and any third-party libraries used. All work should rely on standard, widely supported web tech—no heavy frameworks required—so maintenance stays simple on my end.

opportunities.title: Format WhatsApp Chats in Word
opportunities.description: I have exported several WhatsApp chats and their accompanying media folder. I need the raw text and every image, video, voice note, or sticker turned into a polished .docx file. Please arrange the content so each conversation begins on a fresh, clearly-titled section. Within a section keep the messages in the order they were sent, preserving timestamps and sender names exactly as they appear in the export. When a media file is referenced, embed it inline at the correct spot; if a specific file is missing, simply note “[missing file]” so the flow stays clear. Deliverable: one Word document (Office 2016 or newer compatible) that is easy to scroll, search, and print, containing all conversations and embedded media.

opportunities.title: Mobile-Friendly 3-Page Business Site
opportunities.description: I’m looking for a web developer who can turn my copy, logo, and images into a clean, modern-and-minimalist business website that looks great on mobile as well as desktop screens. The build is straightforward: three pages—Home, Services, and Contact—styled in neutral whites, grays, and blacks. Key elements I need in place: • A contact form with Name, Email, Message, and Phone Number fields that routes submissions to my inbox without fail. • A floating WhatsApp button that opens a chat to my business number. • Basic on-page SEO setup—proper heading structure, meta titles/descriptions, alt tags, and an XML sitemap. I’ll deliver all text and imagery upfront. Please factor in two revision cycles after your first full draft; the final site should be ready to launch within 10–14 days from kickoff. Kindly keep domain and hosting costs itemised separately from the build fee—my development budget is around ₹15,000, split across agreed milestones. Deliverables considered complete when: 1. All three pages render responsively across major browsers and devices. 2. Contact form and WhatsApp button work end-to-end. 3. SEO basics are verified via Google’s inspection tool. 4. I sign off after the second revision round. If this fits your skill set and timeline, I’d love to see your proposal and a couple of minimalist sites you’ve recently shipped.

opportunities.title: App de Estudio para Ciudadanía EEUU
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar una aplicación móvil que ayude a futuros ciudadanos de Estados Unidos a estudiar y practicar todo el proceso de naturalización con una dinámica similar a Duolingo. El proyecto debe cubrir tanto iOS como Android y mantenerse fiel a tres pilares esenciales: • Lecciones interactivas: ejercicios de speaking y writing guiados, tarjetas de memoria para las 128 preguntas oficiales de civics y pequeños retos gamificados que mantengan la motivación diaria. • Simulaciones de entrevista: un flujo que recree la entrevista real, con reconocimiento de voz, temporizador y retroalimentación automática para que el usuario sepa qué mejorar. • Evaluaciones de progreso: paneles que muestren estadísticas, rachas, badges y recomendaciones de estudio personalizadas. Necesito un equipo o desarrollador con experiencia comprobable en apps educativas, gamificación y publicación en App Store/Google Play. El alcance incluye: – Diseño de UX/UI alineado con la estética “Duolingo-like”. – Desarrollo completo de front-end (Flutter, React Native o nativo; estoy abierto a propuestas) y back-end con autenticación, almacenamiento seguro y analíticas. – Integración de bases de datos oficiales de USCIS para el civics test. – Pruebas unitarias y de usabilidad, además de soporte para la primera publicación en ambas tiendas. –Entregar Código fuente completo (frontend + backend) Acceso total al repositorio (GitHub o similar) Sin dependencias ocultas y un pequeño manual de administración de contenidos. Indica en tu propuesta tu stack sugerido, ejemplos de apps similares que hayas publicado y el cronograma estimado para un MVP funcional. Estoy listo para empezar tan pronto encontremos el ajuste perfecto.
